parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: The description of the dataset. The value can be up to 1024 characters in length.

parameters.name: DataType
parameters.description:
The data type. Valid values:
- COMMON: general-purpose (default).
- PIC: image.
- TEXT: text.
- TABLE: table.
- VIDEO: video.
- AUDIO: audio.
- INDEX: index.

parameters.name: InitVersion
parameters.description: The initial version of the dataset.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the dataset. The value must be a non-empty string that is up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: The origin of the dataset. Only DataWorks is supported.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the DataWorks workspace.

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description:
The storage type. Valid values:
- OSS: Object Storage Service.
- NAS: general-purpose NAS file storage.
- EXTREMENAS: extreme NAS file storage.
- DLF_LANCE: Data Lake Formation.
